title: Mango Languages sign-up
summary: The first sign-up must happen on a campus computer.

la: Help students sign up for Mango

sections.title: First sign-up (on campus only)
steps: Sit at a computer on the UNG campus network.
Open the UNG Language Lab web page and choose **Mango Languages** under Links.
**Sign Up** with the UNG email address.
sections.note: Signing up off campus doesn't give UNG access. That's the usual reason it "doesn't work."

sections.title: After that, anywhere
sections.text: Students log in on the web or in the Mango app (App Store or Google Play) with the account they just made.
